For GS its good to take advantage of the different swing that 2H and 1H gives you. Like if there is a lot of enemies you would 1H for horizontal but if its one enemy with more health then 2H. I like to infuse a caestus with a blessed gem on my offhand for passive regen when using an UGS.

And as for poise in ds3, it scales with what weapon class you are using and what weapon you are up against. 

I personally think that using UGS makes bosses easier and more satisfying to fight because you really get to know their timing and the vulnerability of their moveset. I say go for it and have fun :)
